title: PH58038: Non-Linear Optics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Nonlinear Polarization: Introduction, nonlinear electron oscillator model,
nonlinear polarization and wave equation; Nonlinear Optical Processes: Second
and third order parametric processes, phase-matching, saturation nonlinearity,
stimulated Raman scattering, stimulated Brillouin scattering, optical phase
conjugation, self-focusing; Nonlinear Optical Materials: Origin of
nonlinearity, single crystals, polymers, photonic crystals, nanomaterials:
Nonlinear Optics for Communication: Nonlinear fiber optics, temporal soliton,
ultrashort pulse generation and its measurement, Photo refractive effect,
optical bistability; Quantum Optics: Quantum theory of radiation, quantization
of free electromagnetic field, Fock or number States, Lamb shift.
